---
description: "Use when editing the client report, README, presentation, or other business-facing deliverables for this food-demand project."
applyTo: ["README.md", "reports/**/*.md"]
---
# Client Reporting Rules

- Tie every quantitative claim to a reproducible notebook result.
- Separate observed facts, interpretation, and recommendations.
- Include a measurable success metric for each recommendation.
- State data limitations: no real dates, anonymized locations, no inventory/expiry/cost data, and no causal identification.
- Never describe associations from observational data as proof that a promotion or discount caused demand.
